snippet.title: SONIC DEFINITIVE SAGE 2025 DEMO GAMEPLAY (MY NEW FANGAME)
snippet.description:
Sonic Definitive is my new fangame of a short experience that I want to make, for now I want you to enjoy this exclusive demo for sage 2025.
DOWNLOAD HERE!
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/sonic-definitive-demo.2543/

Credits:
Animated Cinematics by 
@ezart.digital https://www.instagram.com/ezart.digital/

Sonic and related characters are SEGA
-Click Team Fusion 2.5+
-Modern Sonic Worlds engine by Yonatankr
-Simple Sonic Worlds engine by Lake Feperd
-Sonic Worlds Delta 1.5.2 by Damizean, MCKaosu, LarkSS, Techokami, Sparks, Mr. Potatobadger, Ice God 64, and Lange

Music:
Sonic Forces - Sonic Forces Overcloked by Tabebo
Silent Dreams
Ruby
TurboAlt
Teddyloid
KingSpartaX37
Sega - Sonic Team
 (Instagram) and Yesmen10

Thanks to:
